record.original_question: Is there a metric of negative curvature for which the ratio of largest positive Lyapunov exponent to smallest positive Lyapunov exponent is greater than 2 for typical geodesics (not just exceptional closed geodesics)?

evidence.quote: Is there a metric of negative curvature for which the ratio of largest positive Lyapunov exponent to smallest positive Lyapunov exponent is greater than 2 for typical geodesics (not just exceptional closed geodesics)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a closed Riemannian manifold of dimension $n\ge 3$ with all sectional curvatures negative, and let $\phi_t:T^1M\to T^1M$ denote its geodesic flow on the unit tangent bundle, preserving the Liouville (normalized volume) measure $\mu$. By the Oseledec multiplicative ergodic theorem, for $\mu$-almost every $v\in T^1M$ the derivative cocycle $d\phi_t$ admits Lyapunov exponents
$$\lambda_1(v)\ge \lambda_2(v)\ge \cdots \ge \lambda_{n-1}(v) > 0 > -\lambda_{n-1}(v)\ge \cdots \ge -\lambda_1(v),$$
together with a zero exponent in the flow direction. Since $(M,g,\phi_t,\mu)$ is ergodic, the functions $\lambda_i$ are $\mu$-almost surely constant; denote these constants by $\lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_{n-1}>0$.

Question: Does there exist such a closed negatively curved Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ for which
$$\frac{\lambda_1}{\lambda_{n-1}} > 2\,?$$
That is, can the ratio of the largest to the smallest positive Lyapunov exponent of the geodesic flow with respect to Liouville measure (i.e. for $\mu$-typical geodesics, not merely along exceptional closed geodesics) strictly exceed $2$?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (Butler 2017; Kalinin–Sadovskaya and successors through 2024–2025) establish rigidity results for equality of Lyapunov exponents of geodesic flows in negative curvature, but I found no source resolving whether the ratio of the largest to smallest positive Lyapunov exponent for the Liouville measure can exceed 2 on a typical (non-periodic) orbit. The status of this specific quantitative question appears unresolved in the literature retrieved.

status_evidence.title: Rigidity of equality of Lyapunov exponents for geodesic flows (Butler)
status_evidence.snippet: Rigidity results when all Lyapunov exponents on the unstable bundle are equal, implying constant negative curvature under pinching.
status_evidence.claim: Existing rigidity theorems address equality of Lyapunov exponents, not the explicit ratio bound > 2.

status_evidence.title: Rigidity of Lyapunov Exponents for Geodesic Flows
status_evidence.snippet: Further rigidity statements for Lyapunov exponents of geodesic flows in non-positive/negative curvature.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to study Lyapunov spectrum rigidity but does not address the ratio>2 question for typical geodesics.

status_evidence.title: Curvature Rigidity Through Level Sets of Lyapunov Exponents in Geodesic Flows
status_evidence.snippet: Studies level sets of Lyapunov exponents and curvature rigidity.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit resolution of whether typical-orbit Lyapunov ratio can exceed 2 in negative curvature.
